description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.t
reasoning: This gazette is a Customs Notification that establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is an exercise of regulatory authority (by the Director General of Customs under Section 17 of the Ordinance) to set and modify financial parameters for trade and taxation. The core content is the publication of a new regulation (the schedule of rates) and the rescission of a previous one, which squarely fits the **Legal/Regulatory** classification (Type 5) for "regulatory frameworks," "statutory instruments," and "legal notices." It does not concern government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, or Elections.
